title: Within-session 1-kHz threshold inconsistency does not improve cross-cycle balance-failure prediction beyond hearing levels
abstract: Mean absolute disagreement between within-sequence 1-kHz readings did not establish incremental prediction of first-trial foam-eyes-closed balance failure beyond hearing levels and covariates across two NHANES samples: target Brier reduction -0.00181114, two-sample coefficient-refit PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.00878441, 0.00037697].
